title: ArnasDon/wacrm
claim: ArnasDon/wacrm — Self-hostable CRM template for WhatsApp — shared inbox, contacts, sales pipelines, broadcasts, and no-code automations.
why_good: Forks (~4,600) run near triple the stars (~1,750). People are not bookmarking it, they are standing up their own instances — the tell that an unserved population of agencies and small businesses wants a WhatsApp CRM it owns.
value: The money is not the template, it is what forkers cannot do themselves: hosting, number provisioning, deliverability, and broadcast compliance, priced per seat or per conversation. WhatsApp is the default storefront for small businesses across Brazil, India, Indonesia and the Gulf, so a hosted localized build sold through agencies is a real SMB SaaS.
risk: Every fork is a potential competitor, and the whole thing sits on Meta's terms — Cloud API repricing or a crackdown on unofficial clients can reset the economics overnight. Wati, Respond.io and 360dialog already hold the paid tier with official BSP status, which a self-host template does not have.
does: A Next.js + Supabase CRM built around WhatsApp as the sales channel — shared team inbox, contacts, deal pipelines, bulk broadcasts, no-code automations — packaged to be forked and rebranded rather than used as-is.
edge: Forks (~4,600) run near triple the stars (~1,750). People are not bookmarking it, they are standing up their own instances — the tell that an unserved population of agencies and small businesses wants a WhatsApp CRM it owns.
why_use: Fastest path to a branded, self-hosted WhatsApp CRM without building the inbox plumbing.
hook: Transform WhatsApp into a powerful CRM with wacrm's self-hostable template!

zh.claim: 将WhatsApp转变为强大的CRM，使用wacrm的自托管模板！
zh.hook: 将WhatsApp转变为强大的CRM，使用wacrm的自托管模板！
zh.does: 基于 Next.js + Supabase 的 CRM，把 WhatsApp 当作销售主渠道：团队共享收件箱、联系人、销售管道、群发、无代码自动化，设计上就是让人 fork 后改名自用，而不是直接用。
zh.edge: fork 数（约 4,600）接近 star 数（约 1,750）的三倍。人们不是收藏，而是真的在自建实例——这说明有一批代理商和中小商家想要一套自己拥有的 WhatsApp CRM，而现在没人满足他们。
zh.why_use: 不用自己写收件箱底座，就能最快得到一套带自有品牌、可自托管的 WhatsApp CRM。
zh.value: 赚钱的不是模板本身，而是 fork 的人自己做不了的部分：托管、号码开通、送达率、群发合规，按坐席或按会话收费。WhatsApp 是巴西、印度、印尼和海湾地区中小商家的默认门店，做成托管化、本地化版本再通过代理商分发，是一门真实的中小企业 SaaS。
zh.risk: 每个 fork 都可能是竞争对手，而且整件事建立在 Meta 的规则之上——Cloud API 调价或封杀非官方客户端就能一夜改写账本。Wati、Respond.io、360dialog 已经握着付费市场和官方 BSP 资质，自托管模板没有这层资质。
zh.why_good: fork 数（约 4,600）接近 star 数（约 1,750）的三倍。人们不是收藏，而是真的在自建实例——这说明有一批代理商和中小商家想要一套自己拥有的 WhatsApp CRM，而现在没人满足他们。

pick_reason: The project addresses a specific need for self-hostable CRM solutions tailored for WhatsApp, with clear monetization potential.
